title: ntp-info
author: Richard Sammet
description: Gets the time and configuration variables from an NTP server. We send two requests: a time request and a "read variables" (opcode 2) control message. Without verbosity, the script shows the time and the value of the version, processor, system, refid, and stratum variables. With verbosity, all variables are shown. See RFC 1035 and the Network Time Protocol Version 4 Reference and Implementation Guide (http://www.eecis.udel.edu/~mills/database/reports/ntp4/ntp4.pdf) for documentation of the protocol.
